resources.string: USB, ADB and MTP are off. Tap Stop to restore.

This mode needs ROOT and rewrites the phone\'s USB gadget configuration. While an image is exposed, normal USB stops: no file transfer (MTP), no ADB, no USB tethering. Your PC will only see the disk image. Stop restores the original setup. If restore ever fails, rebooting the phone resets USB. Only a verified image file is shared, read-only. The phone\'s own storage and partitions are never exposed. Some kernels can\'t do this at all.
The phone\'s USB will switch to a read-only disk. MTP, ADB and tethering stop until you press Stop & restore USB. If the phone misbehaves, reboot it to restore USB. Continue?
